headline: Executive order directs federal attention to equity, justice, and opportunity for Asian Americans, Native Hawaiians, and Pacific Islanders.
what_it_does: President Biden signed this executive order on May 28, 2021. Its title says it aims to advance equity, justice, and opportunity for Asian Americans, Native Hawaiians, and Pacific Islanders. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, offices, or programs it sets up cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.group: Asian Americans, Native Hawaiians, and Pacific Islanders
who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at improving equity, justice, and opportunity for these communities, though the specific measures are not described in the available information.
As an executive order, it likely gives instructions to parts of the federal government, but the details are not available here.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 28, 2021; executive orders generally take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
